name: @streamline-pulse/creeba-core
description: Portable Creeba P2P core: generic presence, peers and routing of opaque app payloads over a pluggable SyncTransport. No native dependency — usable from Bun, Node, browser or React Native. Message shape and persistence belong to the application.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/fix-dts.mjs dist
